Helping dogs move, feel, and age better 🐾

I’m Dr. Amanda Kremer, an AVCA-certified animal chiropractor in Lake Tahoe specializing in dogs, cats, and rabbits.

On this channel you’ll learn:
• how to improve your dog’s mobility
• exercises for strength & stability
• injury prevention and recovery tips
• what healthy movement should look like
• how chiropractic care helps pets live longer, active lives

📍 Incline Village / Lake Tahoe
🌐 chiro4critters.com
